_comment: Selects the active body-outline shader. movement_tracker.py reads this file ~1x/sec and broadcasts it on OSC so TouchDesigner can switch shaders live. Edit 'mode' and save — no tracker restart needed. See docs/setup/visual_mode_toggle.md.
_audio_comment: Audio-analysis input device UID for /project1/audio_in. THE knob for reactivity: set this to whatever device carries your set (BlackHole2ch_UID, VirtualAudio_UID, an interface UID, ...). Both audio setters honor it; they no longer auto-grab Serato Virtual Audio.
